source_issue.title: 2011 data files are missing, and reports skip missing years without warning

summary_markdown:
# Issue #43: Missing 2011 Data Files

## What this issue is about
This issue addresses the absence of data files for the year 2011 in the `plone-contributor-statistics` repository. Specifically, the files `data/2011-plone-contributors.csv` and `data/2011-plone-organisation-contributors.csv` are missing, which causes reports to skip over 2011 without notifying users.

## What needs to be done
1. Create the missing data files for 2011.
2. Update the report generators (`generate_contributor_report.py` and `generate_volto_team_report.py`) to issue warnings or errors if any requested year lacks data.

## Helpful background
The missing data impacts reports that cover a range of years including 2011, resulting in understated statistics. While the reports published so far are unaffected, fixing this will ensure future reports provide accurate information.

## Good first steps
1. Check if you can create the necessary CSV files for 2011, using data from previous years as a reference.
2. Familiarize yourself with the report generators by reviewing their code.
3. Consider contributing by implementing the warning/error handling for missing years.   
4. Reach out for guidance if anything is unclear, as some discussion points in the issue may need clarification.
